name: Nimble Links
description: Nimble Links is a powerful tool designed to streamline your URL management and enhance your online presence. With its intuitive interface, you can easily shorten, track, and manage your links, making it an essential tool for marketers and businesses looking to optimize their digital strategies.

events.d: Shorten a URL into a shareable short link.
Create a short link that sends visitors to a random destination from the list of destination.
Creates a link that distributes traffic evenly between multiple destination URLs.
Creates a link that requires a password to access before redirecting to the destination URL.
